================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO YA AFTER EFFECTS - MAKAMBO YA SIKA
Version 9.2.9  -  Octobre 2026
================================================================================

BA THÈME YA ANIME 33 ya sika ebakisami pembeni ya oyo ya Demon Slayer, ba effet
ya souris ya ba thème emonanaka sikoyo solo na kati ya After Effects, mpe
Sélecteur de thème ekómi liste moko ya kofungola oyo ebongi malamu.

LIBOSO YA KOBANDA
- Installer likolo ya version na yo ya sikoyo na installateur ya ZXP na yo ya
  ntango nyonso, sima banda After Effects lisusu mbala moko.
- Ba réglage na yo, thème, ba preset mpe ba expression oyo obombaki ekotikala.

SIKA: BA THÈME YA ANIME 33
- Ba réglage ya Flex > SELECTEUR DE THEME > THEME YA PANNEAU ezali sikoyo na
  groupe moko mpo na anime moko na moko: Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts),
  Black Clover (Asta), Bleach (Ichigo, Hitsugaya), Chainsaw Man (Denji, Reze),
  Code Geass (Lelouch), Dandadan (Okarun), Death Note (Kira), Dragon Ball
  (Goku), Frieren, Fullmetal Alchemist (Edward), Hunter x Hunter (Killua,
  Kurapika, Hisoka), Jujutsu Kaisen (Gojo, Sukuna), KonoSuba (Megumin),
  Mob Psycho 100 (Mob), My Hero Academia (Bakugo, Deku, Todoroki), Naruto
  (Itachi, Minato), One Piece (Luffy, Zoro, Law), One-Punch Man (Saitama),
  Re:Zero (Rem), Solo Leveling (Jinwoo), Spy x Family (Anya) mpe Tokyo Ghoul
  (Kaneki).
- Moto moko na moko ya lisolo azali na lolenge na ye: oyo elandaka souris na yo,
  attaque ntango ofinaka bouton, oyo esalemaka ntango osimbi bouton ya gauche,
  mpe explosion sima ya pene ya sekonde 2.5 ya kosimba.
- Pɛpɛ lokola ba thème ya Demon Slayer: ba effet esalaka kaka ntango ozali
  kotambolisa souris to kofina. Zimisa BA EFFECT YA AMBIANCE po obatela kaka ba
  couleur.

EBONGWANI: SELECTEUR DE THEME
- Ba carte ya Demon Slayer na nse ya THEME YA PANNEAU elongwe, yango wana
  Ba réglage ya Flex ekómi mokuse. Pona thème nyonso na liste THEME YA PANNEAU;
  efungwamaka na thème oyo ozali kosalela.
- Kurama mpe Baryon bazali sikoyo na groupe ya Naruto.

EBONGISAMI
- Ba effet ya souris ya ba thème (mai, móto, nkake mpe mosusu) mbala mingi
  ezalaki komonana te na kati ya After Effects, ata soki Optimised Mode ezalaki
  ya kozima. Ntango panneau yango moko ezalaki na mosala mingi, mpe ebandeli ya
  kilo, bazalaki kokanisa ete thème ezali kotambola malembe, yango wana ba effet
  ezalaki komizimisa yango moko. Sikoyo, soki carte graphique na yo nde ezali
  kobenda yango (ba ordinateur mingi), ntango wana ekomisaka kaka ba effet pɛpɛ
  mwa moke.

EBONGWANI TE
- Licence, activation mpe ba lien nyonso esalaka ndenge moko lokola liboso.
- Ba thème 11 ya Demon Slayer emonanaka ndenge moko lokola na 9.2.8.
- Ba onglet mosusu nyonso mpe ba outil esalaka ndenge moko lokola na 9.2.8.
================================================================================
